---
title: "Metadata Catalog & JSON Artifacts"
format: html
---

GeoCroissant recipes generate machine-readable JSON-LD documents describing geospatial machine learning datasets. Every metadata document conforms to schema.org, MLCommons Croissant, and the GeoCroissant vocabulary extension.

This catalog indexes all metadata artifacts across the recipes, provides direct links to inspect the raw files, and explains how to view and query them.

## Viewing Metadata Files

### 1. In the Browser
When running `quarto preview` or browsing the built site, click any file link in the table below to open the raw JSON or Turtle document directly in your browser. Browsers with built-in JSON viewers or extensions (such as JSON Viewer) will format, fold, and highlight the structure automatically.

### 2. Using Python and mlcroissant
Load and inspect any GeoCroissant JSON-LD file directly with the `mlcroissant` library:

```python
import json
import mlcroissant as mlc

# Load and validate the dataset
dataset = mlc.Dataset("Introduction to Geocroissant/hls_burn_scars.json")

# Access dataset-level metadata
metadata = dataset.metadata
print(f"Dataset Name: {metadata.name}")
print(f"License: {metadata.license}")

# Access RecordSets and fields
for record_set in metadata.record_sets:
    print(f"RecordSet: {record_set.name}")
    for field in record_set.fields:
        print(f"  Field: {field.name} ({field.data_type})")
```

### 3. Command Line Inspection
Pretty-print or query any metadata file with `jq`:

```bash
# Pretty-print top-level properties
jq '{name, "geocr:coordinateReferenceSystem", "geocr:spatialResolution"}' \
  "Introduction to Geocroissant/hls_burn_scars.json"

# List all record fields
jq '.recordSet[].field[].name' \
  "Introduction to Geocroissant/hls_burn_scars.json"
```

## Sample Metadata Previews

### Core GeoCroissant Record (`hls_burn_scars.json`)

```json
{
  "@context": {
    "@language": "en",
    "@vocab": "https://schema.org/",
    "cr": "http://mlcommons.org/croissant/",
    "geocr": "http://mlcommons.org/croissant/geo/",
    "rai": "http://mlcommons.org/croissant/RAI/",
    "dct": "http://purl.org/dc/terms/",
    "conformsTo": "dct:conformsTo",
    "recordSet": "cr:recordSet",
    "field": "cr:field"
  },
  "@type": "Dataset",
  "name": "hls-burn-scars",
  "description": "Harmonized Landsat-Sentinel-2 (HLS) Burn Scars dataset for wildfire detection.",
  "conformsTo": [
    "http://mlcommons.org/croissant/1.1",
    "http://mlcommons.org/croissant/geo/1.0"
  ],
  "spatialCoverage": {
    "@type": "Place",
    "geo": {
      "@type": "GeoShape",
      "box": "24.396308 -124.848974 49.384358 -66.885444"
    }
  },
  "geocr:coordinateReferenceSystem": "EPSG:32610",
  "geocr:spatialResolution": {
    "@type": "sc:QuantitativeValue",
    "value": 30,
    "unitText": "m"
  },
  "geocr:bandConfiguration": {
    "@type": "geocr:BandConfiguration",
    "geocr:totalBands": 6,
    "geocr:bandNamesList": ["Blue", "Green", "Red", "NIR", "SWIR1", "SWIR2"]
  }
}
```

### Heliophysics Record (`sdo_surya_bench.json`)

```json
{
  "@type": "Dataset",
```

### Multi-Temporal Time-Series Record (`sentinel2_timeseries.json`)

```json
{
  "@type": "Dataset",
  "name": "sentinel2-timeseries",
  "geocr:temporalResolution": {
    "@type": "sc:QuantitativeValue",
    "value": 1,
    "unitText": "month"
  },
  "recordSet": [
    {
      "@type": "cr:RecordSet",
      "@id": "timeseries_recordset",
      "geocr:timeSeriesIndex": {
        "@id": "timeseries_recordset/timestamp"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
